subject: Gen5 Beta1 CI failed safely: stale regression-test filter blocks runtime commit
body: GitHub support commit b9bee812be0291f3956b698f46fe00ef45f188a6 triggered Apply Duo Open Gen5 Beta1 Virtual Hinge run 36981087516. Exact baseline PASS, support checksums PASS, patcher syntax/apply PASS, invariant validation PASS, and compileFullDebugKotlin was UP-TO-DATE/successful. Focused regression step then FAILED because Gradle filter '*Fold7CoverVisualAttemptOwnerTest' matches no tests. Current source class is Fold7CoverVisualAttemptOwnerGen3Test.kt. Full gate, runtime commit, APK preparation/upload were skipped, so no Gen5 runtime code reached main. Required CI delta: change workflow filter to '*Fold7CoverVisualAttemptOwnerGen3Test' (or an exact current class selector), then rerun only after incorporating the separate manager integration blockers already published. Historical Build Z Fold 7 Motion-Gated Cover Power 1.3.16 also failed on the support push before the staged patch could make that workflow manual-only; do not treat that historical failure as Gen5 runtime evidence.
